contact.subtitle: Pick whichever channel you like. For project work the form below works too — it validates locally and tells you what it thinks.
contact.title: Get in touch

footer.tagline: All motion built with CSS / JavaScript / Canvas

card.body: The side bar is a CSS gradient that grows to the full edge on hover.
card.body2: Cards use a very low-opacity gradient so the black base stays dominant.
card.body3: On hover a card lifts 3px, brightens its border and sweeps a highlight across the top edge.

gallery.subtitle: The reusable components and the palette, all in one place. Every element shares the same design tokens, so switching the accent repaints the whole site at once.
gallery.title: Style gallery

about.line2: A zero-dependency single-page site that treats the terminal as its interface language:

cta.body: The tools page ships a working terminal: try help, ls, neofetch, or use accent to change the highlight colour.
cta.title: Want to poke at it right now?

1.body: Perspective grid, drifting wireframe polygons and constellation links — all drawn live on canvas, with the shape count scaling to the viewport.
1.title: Animated geometry

2.body: When the navigation expands, every link drags a string of ghosts that lag behind the same path, fading and blurring — composited with screen blending for a glow.
2.title: Motion-blur trails

3.body: Hash routing with prefetched fragments: the old view blurs and drifts up, the new one blurs in behind it, and the page never once reloads.
3.title: Reload-free routing

4.body: Full keyboard navigation, visible focus styles and ARIA labels; with “reduce motion” enabled, the trails and background animation switch themselves off.
4.title: Accessible by default

features.subtitle: Four things: geometry, motion, no reloads, restraint.
features.title: Core features

home.subtitle: A terminal-flavoured metaphor: CSS, JavaScript and Canvas used to build an interaction that feels fluid, restrained and tactile. Every page swap happens in the same DOM — nothing is ever reloaded.

home.desc: Start here — what this site is about
home.label: Home

tools.desc: A mini terminal that actually works, plus small utilities
tools.label: Tools

1.body: Two commands, b64 and b64d, with full UTF-8 round-tripping.
1.title: Base64 encode / decode

2.body: Prefers crypto.randomUUID and falls back to getRandomValues.
2.title: UUID v4 generator

3.body: Expands minified JSON into an indented tree and reports where parsing failed.
3.title: JSON formatter

4.body: WebCrypto hashing — available over https or localhost.
4.title: SHA-256 digest

5.body: accent red | green | blue recolours the whole site and remembers your choice.
5.title: Accent colour

6.body: Type open contact (or any other page) into the terminal to switch views.
6.title: In-shell navigation

grid.subtitle: Everything happens client-side; nothing is ever sent to a server.
grid.title: Inside the box

tools.note: Note: the terminal is a front-end demo — commands and output are generated locally. Press Ctrl+L to clear the screen.
tools.subtitle: A handful of utilities that run entirely in the browser. The terminal keeps history (↑/↓), completes on Tab and ships a tiny virtual filesystem.
tools.title: Tools
